metadata.title: Patryk Niedbalski — Full-Stack Developer | React, Next.js, Node.js
metadata.description: Full-stack developer based in Warsaw, Poland. I build websites, web applications and business systems with React, Next.js and Node.js. Available for projects and open to long-term B2B or full-time roles.

hero.description: I design and build websites, web applications and business systems - from a landing page to a booking platform or an admin panel. I take care of the whole thing: frontend, backend and deployment.

bio.paragraph1: I'm a full-stack developer based in Warsaw. I enjoy turning complex problems into simple solutions - the kind that are just easy to use.
bio.paragraph2: Throughout my career, I've worked in companies with different profiles - from startups and software houses to companies partnering with some of the world’s largest corporations, building everything from internal tools to customer-facing platforms. I thrive in collaborative environments where good ideas can come from anywhere.
bio.availability: I currently build projects for businesses and I'm open to a long-term role - B2B contract or full-time - in a team that builds a product. If you're hiring, send me a message or reach out on LinkedIn.
bio.paragraph3: When I'm not coding, you'll find me spending time with family, traveling, reading books, or playing football.

services.heading: How I can help
services.description: A new website, a custom system, or improving what you already have - I handle the whole thing, from idea to launch.

frontend.title: Websites & web apps
frontend.description: Company websites, landing pages and web apps that load fast, work well on mobile and guide visitors towards getting in touch or buying. From the interface to deployment and analytics setup.

backend.title: Business systems & admin panels
backend.description: Booking systems, admin panels, payment and third-party API integrations. I design the database and business logic so the system grows with your company and keeps your data safe.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: Copying data by hand, sending the same emails, stitching reports together in Excel? I build tools and scripts that do it for you and give your team their time back.

performance.title: Speed & search visibility
performance.description: I speed up existing websites and apps, improve Core Web Vitals, and set up technical SEO and analytics - so your site is easier to find and doesn't lose customers to slow loading.

projects.heading: Selected work
projects.description: Projects I've worked on - from platforms for large organisations to a marketplace and company websites.

faq.heading: Questions? I've got answers
faq.description: What's worth knowing before we start working together.

services.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
services.answer: Company websites and landing pages, online stores, booking systems, admin panels, MVPs for startups and automations. I work with small businesses as well as large organisations.

pricing.question: How much does a website or app cost?
pricing.answer: A simple landing page starts at 2,000 PLN, a website with a management panel at 3,500 PLN, and custom systems are quoted individually (net prices). After a short call I'll prepare an exact quote broken down into stages.

timeline.question: How long does a project take?
timeline.answer: A simple website usually takes a few weeks; larger apps and systems take longer. I'll give you a realistic timeline once we've discussed the scope.

collaboration.question: Can you work with our existing team?
collaboration.answer: Of course. I work alongside designers, product managers and other developers every day. I adapt to your tools and processes, not the other way around.

hiring.question: Are you open to a long-term or full-time role?
hiring.answer: Yes. Alongside client projects I'm open to a long-term B2B contract or a full-time role in a product team. Send me a message or reach out on LinkedIn.

start.question: How do we get started?
start.answer: Send me a message with a short description of what you need. I'll get back to you to set up a call and go through the details.

contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.description: Tell me briefly what you need - a website, a system, an automation, or someone to join your team. I'll get back to you to set up a call.

privacy.metaDescription: ITPapi privacy policy: data controller, contact form, cookies and your rights as a data subject.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Below I explain in plain language how I process personal data in line with the GDPR.

controller.heading: 1. Data controller
controller.body:
The controller of your personal data is Patryk Niedbalski, Tax ID (NIP): 1132813373, Warsaw, Poland (ITPapi, www.itpapi.pl).

Contact for data protection matters: patrykitpapi@gmail.com.

data.heading: 2. What data I collect and why
data.body:
When you write to me through the contact form, I process the data you provide: full name, email address, phone number (optional), subject and message.

I use it to respond to your inquiry and to take steps before entering into a contract, if you ask for that, and to carry on correspondence.

After submitting the form you receive an automatic confirmation email with fixed text. Form data is not stored in a database on this site; it reaches me as an email.

legalBasis.heading: 3. Legal basis
legalBasis.body:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR – processing is necessary to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract.

Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR – the controller's legitimate interest in handling correspondence and answering inquiries.

Analytics (Google Analytics) runs only with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and consent for access to information on your device).

recipients.heading: 4. Recipients of data
recipients.body:
Your data may be processed by the providers whose services I use:

Vercel Inc. – website hosting.

Resend – delivery of the form email and the automatic reply.

Google – Google Analytics, only if you consent to analytics cookies.

I do not share data with anyone else unless required by law.

transfers.heading: 5. Transfers outside the EEA
transfers.body:
These providers are based or operate infrastructure in the United States, so your data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area.

Transfers rely on safeguards provided for in the GDPR, in particular the European Commission's adequacy decision on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework for certified recipients, or standard contractual clauses. You can ask me for information about the safeguards applied.

retention.heading: 6. How long I keep data
retention.body:
I keep data for as long as needed to handle your inquiry and any resulting cooperation, and afterwards until potential claims become time-barred, unless you object to the processing or request erasure earlier and there is no legal obstacle.

Analytics data processed by Google is subject to that provider's retention rules.

rights.heading: 7. Your rights
rights.body:
You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to data portability, and to object to processing based on legitimate interest.

Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO), ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland.

To exercise your rights, email patrykitpapi@gmail.com.

voluntary.heading: 8. Providing data is voluntary
voluntary.body: Providing data is voluntary, but your name, email address and message are needed for me to reply. Without them I cannot handle your inquiry.

automated.heading: 9. Automated decisions
automated.body: I do not make automated decisions about you and do not use profiling.

cookies.heading: 10. Cookies and local storage
cookies.body:
This site uses the following items:

theme-mode (cookie and localStorage) – remembers your light/dark theme choice; functional and needed for the setting to work.

cookie-consent (localStorage) – remembers your cookie choice.

_ga and _ga_* (Google Analytics cookies, ID G-8Z9E33KK05) – visit statistics; set only after you give consent.

You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" button in the site footer. Rejecting or withdrawing consent deletes the Google Analytics cookies.
